events.name: Baby Face Dance
events.description: You're the dancer in the dorm room: full length in a white T-shirt, you kick, swing your arms, sink into a wide squat with both hands on your head, bend right over to the side, drop to one knee and finish low with your arms crossed.

events.name: Big Biscuit Johnson
events.description: Three friends in matching beige suits crowd a cake-shop window while the seller walks a spatula across a tray of syrup-soaked cake: the one in front covers their eyes until the slice is big enough, points how much, and the giant slice comes up to the glass.

events.name: Camden Bop
events.description: You at home in a black t-shirt and grey joggers: you grin into the phone, back up to the middle of the living room and give the Camden Bop your best first try, bouncing, flinging an arm up, kicking a heel back and finally laughing with a hand on your forehead.

events.name: Christmas Chibi Heart
events.description: You and your person as big-head chibi Santas in front of a glowing Christmas tree, one sitting on the other's shoulders, both making finger hearts while little pink hearts float up around you.

events.name: Cleaning My Boyfriend's PS5
events.description: You at the edge of a full jet bathtub, smiling at your phone as you let your boyfriend's white games console slide into the water to 'clean' it, then toss the controller in after it.

events.name: Fan Jumps Into the Ring
events.description: You're the fan at the ringside barrier: you stare down the huge wrestler, roar, shove through the crowd, climb into the ring, trade blows, slam him flat and stand over him for the low close-up.

events.name: Grim Reaper Grandma Cat
events.description: On a snowy Christmas night the Grim Reaper waits at the door; Grandma (you) smiles, hauls Grandpa out of his armchair, pushes him out to Death and hugs the cat (your pet) instead.

events.name: Heart Frame Portrait
events.description: A black and white beauty close-up of you making a heart with both hands around one eye, with only that eye, your lips and your long nails left in colour.

events.name: Jupiter Incident
events.description: A grainy black-and-white astronaut portrait of you, on a black 'JUPITER INCIDENT (2011)' crew page with your status stamped underneath: DECEASED, or the only one who made it home.

events.name: RedRed Dance
events.description: You dance the RedRed Dance alone in a plain white corridor: you stand still by the door, then bounce toward the camera, cross your forearms over your face, flap your hands by your ears, kick, spin and run out of the shot.

events.name: Run Around the Earth
events.description: You crouch at a white start line in the desert while a hand holds up a stopwatch, blast off in a cloud of dust, race through a forest, across polar ice, past the Arc de Triomphe, around the Earth from space and along a beach, then skid back to the line as the stopwatch stops at 9.83.

events.name: Second Day of Boxing
events.description: It's your second day at boxing lessons: gloves up and grinning in the living room, you try to dodge a water bottle swinging on a rope, duck too late, get bonked on the head and keep swinging wildly anyway.
